hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(rm -rf|drop table|truncate|format c|mkfs)'; then echo 'Destructive command blocked' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(\.env|\.env\.|credentials|secrets)'; then echo 'Protected file blocked' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$FILE" == *.ts ]] || [[ "$FILE" == *.tsx ]]; then npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
echo 'Context restored. NASA Power of 10 rules active. Check CLAUDE.md for project structure.'
